strengths: Brick bond, directional exterior and interior wood grain, glazing transmission, rain-aged plaster history and warm/cool material separation survive real architectural assemblies rather than only isolated swatches.
Exterior weathering is declared in real metre scales and remains independent from host-object bounds.
The same renderer-independent definitions remain legible under neutral overcast exterior and off-axis warm-key/cool-fill interior lighting.
limitations: The suite is accepted for background and medium shots, not hero macro material photography.
Limestone and plaster structure is intentionally restrained and depends on grazing light; neither contains scanned displacement or unique damage decals.
The interior alcove is a verification fixture rather than a finished room and contains no populated shelf inventory.
Glazing dirt and scratches remain procedural and subtle; close-up condensation, fingerprints, chips and edge sealing are not claimed.
notes: Accepted only when fail-closed verification binds every material to its relevant covered gallery entity, four diagnostic views, complete geometry/material identity, and the physical glazing or exterior-weathering semantics applicable to that surface.
